# NIST’s AI Risk Management Framework and Its Generative AI Profile

NIST released the AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0) in January 2023 as a voluntary, broad framework to help organizations incorporate trustworthiness considerations across AI design, development, use, and evaluation.

In July 2024, NIST published AI 600-1, a cross-sector companion profile focused on generative AI. The two publications are related but distinct in scope: the AI RMF addresses AI broadly, while AI 600-1 focuses on generative AI. Its status as a companion profile does not mean it replaces the broader framework.
